title: Hierarchical Diffusion Transformer for End-to-End Image Generation
abstract: arXiv:2611.22962v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Pixel-space diffusion learns visual representations and image generation jointly in a single end-to-end training stage, without a separately pretrained visual encoder. However, plain pixel-space Transformers still trail leading two-stage latent diffusion models in generation quality and training efficiency. We hypothesize that part of this gap arises from retaining one token per patch throughout the backbone, which does not explicitly encourage a visual hierarchy that summarizes related content at progressively coarser levels. To address this, we introduce Hierarchical Diffusion Transformers (HiT), which progressively group related tokens and represent each group with a single token. The main Transformer bottleneck processes these compact group tokens, and ungrouping restores features to their original image positions. A compression budget regulates the average compression ratio across the batch, allowing group memberships and counts t

translated_title: 用于端到端图像生成的层级扩散Transformer
translated_abstract: 像素空间扩散模型在单一的端到端训练阶段中联合学习视觉表示和图像生成，而无需单独预训练的视觉编码器。然而，朴素的像素空间Transformer在生成质量和训练效率方面仍然落后于领先的两阶段潜在扩散模型。我们假设这种差距部分源于在整个骨干网络中每个图像块始终保留一个token的做法，这种方式没有明确鼓励一种能在逐步粗化的层级上总结相关内容的视觉层级结构。为解决这一问题，我们提出了层级扩散Transformer（HiT），它逐步地将相关的token进行分组，并用单个token来表示每个组。主Transformer瓶颈部分处理这些紧凑的组token，而解除分组操作则将特征恢复到其原始的图像位置。压缩预算机制调节整个批次中的平均压缩率，使组成员关系和数量能够……（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 提出层级扩散Transformer（HiT），通过逐步将相关token分组压缩来构建视觉层级结构，使端到端像素空间扩散模型在生成质量和训练效率上追赶领先的两阶段潜在扩散模型。
en_tdlr: We propose Hierarchical Diffusion Transformers (HiT), which progressively group related tokens into compact representations to build a visual hierarchy, enabling end-to-end pixel-space diffusion models to close the gap with leading two-stage latent diffusion models in generation quality and training efficiency.
